options.text: Change the app's manifest to declare the new field
Make Docusign re-read the app's data model for an existing connection, without reinstalling or re-reviewing
Remove and reinstall the app in the account
Have the changed app approved again

decode.explanation: The data model changed after the app was connected, so the account holds the old type definitions; refreshing the connection makes Docusign call Get Type Names and Get Type Definitions again.
clues: 'added a new LoanPurpose property' -> data model changed after connection
'extension test ... returns it correctly' -> back end is fine
'Nothing in the manifest changed' -> no review or manifest edit needed
'OAuth tokens are still valid' -> connection itself is fine
decode.needs: Refresh the extension app's connection in the App Center.

decode.prompt: What must change for production?

options.text: Allow the embedding site and the production Docusign app origin to frame and message, with no demo values
Add trailing slashes to make the origins explicit
Allow messages from the embedding site's own origin
Keep the values that worked in the demo environment

decode.explanation: 'no demo-environment value remains' means apps-d becomes apps.docusign.com in frameAncestors, and messageOrigins is the single production Docusign origin.
clues: 'going live in production' -> apps.docusign.com, not apps-d
'no demo-environment value remains' -> replace apps-d everywhere
'focused view' -> needs frameAncestors and messageOrigins
decode.needs: frameAncestors with site origin plus https://apps.docusign.com; messageOrigins https://apps.docusign.com.
